newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 20.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 34.21 points to 7,228.88 despite prospects the Federal Reserve might raise interest rates on Tuesday.
* The minority United Development Party (PPP) has decided to cancel campaigning in Jakarta on Tuesday to prevent further clashes after campaign violence over the weekend, a party spokesman said.
* On Monday, the Jakarta composite index fell 4.52 points to close at 652.55 points.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,442.50/43.50 at 0140 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,441.00/43.00.
* Ciputra Development after news that subsidiary PT Ciputra Surya planned to issue six-year 300 billion rupiah straight bonds.
* Small-sized property firm Bumi Modern on reports the majority shareholder of the firm planned to sell its stake to PT Bakrie Capital Indonesia.
* Chemical firm Unggul Indah on a proposed acquisition of Salim Oleochemicals Pte Ltd.
* Salt producer Fiskaragung and retailer Matahari on announcements of higher first quarter results.
* Kasogi on reports of a proposed rights issue and a possibility of a link-up with a Brazilian footwear firm.
